XII.}}</noinclude>anointed the feete of {{sc|Iesvs}}, and vviped his feete vvith her heare: and the house vvas filled of the odour of the ointment. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=4}}† One therfore of his disciples, Iudas Iscariote, he that vvas to betray him, said, {{verse|chapter=12|verse=5}}† {{sup|‖}} VVhy vvas not this ointment sold for three-hundred pence, and giuen to the poore? {{verse|chapter=12|verse=6}}† And he said this, not because he cared for the poore: but because he vvas {{sup|‖}} a theefe, and hauing the purse, caried the things that vvere put in. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=7}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} therfore said, Let her alone that she may keepe it for the day of my {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ The deuout offices of balming and anointing the dead}}∷ burial. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=8}}† For the poore you haue alvvaies vvith you: but {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Not in visible and mortal cōdition, to receiue almes of you or such like offices for supply of my necessities.}}∷ me you shal not haue alwaies. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=9}}† A great multitude therfore of the Ievves knevv that he vvas there: and they came, not for {{sc|Iesvs}} only, but that they might see Lazarus, vvhom he raised from the dead.⊣ {{verse|chapter=12|verse=10}}† But the cheefe Priests deuised for to kil Lazarus also: {{verse|chapter=12|verse=11}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Saturday in Passion weeke.}}because many for him of the Ievves vvent avvay, and beleeued in {{sc|Iesvs}}.

{{verse|chapter=12|verse=12}}† And on the morow a great multitude that vvas come to the festiual day, {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ PALME SVNDAY.}}∷ vvhen they had heard that {{sc|Iesvs}} commeth to Hierusalem: {{verse|chapter=12|verse=13}}† they tooke the {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''* Mt. 21, 7. Mr. 11, 7. Lu. 19, 35.''}}* boughes of palmes, and vvent forth to meete him, and cried, ''Hosanna, blessed is he that commeth in the name of our Lord, the king of Israel''.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 117, 26.''}} {{verse|chapter=12|verse=14}}† And {{sc|Iesvs}} found a yong asse, and sate vpon it, as it is vvritten, {{verse|chapter=12|verse=15}}† ''Feare not daughter of Sion: behold, thy king commeth sitting vpon an asses colt''.{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Zach. 9, 9.''}} {{verse|chapter=12|verse=16}}† These things his disciples did not knovv at the first: but vvhen {{sc|Iesvs}} vvas glorified, then they remembred that these things had been vvritten of him, and these things they did to him. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=17}}† The multitude therfore gaue testimonie, vvhich vvas vvith him when he called Lazarus out of the graue, and raised him from the dead. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=18}}† For therfore also the multitude came to meete him, because they heard that he had done this signe. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=19}}† The Pharisees therfore said among them selues, Doe you see that vve preuaile nothing? behold, the vvhole vvorld is gone after him.

{{verse|chapter=12|verse=20}}† And there vvere certaine Gentiles of them that {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ We may see there is a great difference where a man pray or adore, at home or in the Church & holy places: when the Gentils also came of deuotion a pilgrimage to the Temple in Hierusalem.}}∷ came vp to adore in the festiual day. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=21}}† These therfore came to Philippe vvho vvas of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, vve are desirous to see {{sc|Iesvs}}. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=22}}† Philippe commeth, and telleth Andrevv. Againe Andrevv & Philippe told {{sc|Iesvs}}. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=23}}† But {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered them, saying, The houre is come, that the Sonne of man shal be glorified. {{verse|chapter=12|verse=24}}† b {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel for S. Ignatius ''Febr. 1.'' And S. Laurence ''Aug. 10.'' And for some other martyrs not Bishops.}}Amen, amen I say to you, vnles the graine of vvheate falling into the ground,<noinclude>{{rh|||die:}}</noinclude>
